required_runtime.name: node
required_runtime.reason: official @i-xor/lwc npm package engines and native binary installer

required_runtime.name: POSIX shell
required_runtime.reason: scripts/lwc uses /bin/sh, executable permissions and project-local native binary

required_runtime.name: authenticated Codex host
required_runtime.reason: local project discovery, tools, account model availability and policy verified on destination

optional_runtime.name: Poppler pdftotext
optional_runtime.required_when: extract PDF sources or rebuild requiring PDF extraction

optional_runtime.name: document/spreadsheet artifact skill runtimes
optional_runtime.required_when: authoring or rendering DOCX/XLSX artifacts; reinstall or use destination bundled runtimes

lwc.native_binary_policy: reinstall for destination OS and architecture; do not copy node_modules or native binaries
lwc.windows_route: WSL glibc environment with Python, Node and wrapper/MCP executed in same environment; verify host integration
lwc.canonical_policy: SQLite authoritative; only scripts/lwc CLI mutations; generated Markdown is projection
lwc.import_policy: empty destination memory; no automatic overwrite; validate IDs, citations and source-map after import
lwc.backup_policy: stop active readers/writers and copy complete .lwc including present WAL/SHM and checkpoints; never copy only live wiki.db
lwc.checkpoint_vs_compress: checkpoint preserves complete database recovery state; compress is portable semantic memory archive; not assumed byte-identical or equivalent retention
lwc.compact_vs_compress: maintenance compact claims derived/WAL storage; not an archive export; inspector busy
lwc.known_recovery_limitation: LWC0.18.5 sparse draft foreign-key failure documented; explicit checkpoint/live CLI recovery only, not automatic
lwc.forbidden_bootstrap_shortcut: do not run scripts/sync_lwc.py to overwrite richer maintained memory
lwc.post_import_map_reconciliation: scripts/reconcile_lwc_sources.py --apply on destination only after reviewing hash-based plan
lwc.import_numeric_ids_observed: remapped in real local empty-root CLI import; do not reuse old numeric map

codex_project.conflict_policy: preserve customizations separately, compare before regeneration; installer refuses conflicting configuration and preserves existing agent definitions
codex_project.model_policy: project-owned definitions omit model selection; inherit coordinator unless destination host/account overrides
codex_project.config_semantics: OpenAI documents max_concurrent_threads_per_session as spawned children excluding primary; destination configuration must enforce project total limit

mcp.name: erasmus_wiki
mcp.capability: read-only retrieval; authorized knowledge mutations via CLI

codex_project.missing_multiagent_tools: serial production possible; independent accepted fresh-step-v1 gates require actual fresh fork none spawn and observed distinct identity

preserve_as_history: observed spawn/session receipts within selected application dossiers
original source IDs, hashes and provenance

relocation.source_origin_absolute_paths: may refer to old computer; immutable cited content retained; live status may be unresolved
relocation.validation_receipt_absolute_paths: not automatically portable; do not rewrite frozen files to repair locations
relocation.strategy: record old-root to new-root mapping and hashes externally; use read-only audit if available; create new baseline and invalidate first affected stage for resumed changed inputs
relocation.audit_cli_status: scripts/relocation_audit.py implements read-only explicit-root mapping/hash audit; no archive rewriting or automatic gate acceptance

destination_acceptance_checks: LWC doctor/lint, maintained search, cited page/source retrieval
imported source IDs and citations vs source-map
brain rebuilding of only rebuildable evidence index then brain check
dossier status and read-only relocation audit if supported
observed bounded fresh spawn if host offers multiagent tools
write destination result receipt with limitations before declaring operational
never_implied: transfer already tested on another PC
historic receipts validate new host inputs

release.versioning: private immutable ZIP releases with external SHA256 manifests

working_memory.canonical: append-only event log and hash chain; local index rebuildable
working_memory.default_export: engine memory included, candidate memory only with explicitly selected projects
